verses.en: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:
verses.fr: Paul et Timothée, serviteurs de Jésus-Christ, à tous les saints en Jésus-Christ qui sont à Philippes, aux évêques et aux diacres:
verses.am: የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ባሪያዎች የሆኑ ጳውሎስና ጢሞቴዎስ በፊልጵስዩስ ለሚኖሩ ከኤጲስ ቆጶሳትና ከዲያቆናት ጋር በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ላሉት ቅዱሳን ሁሉ፤

verses.en: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.fr: que la grâce et la paix vous soient données de la part de Dieu notre Père et du Seigneur Jésus Christ!
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔር ከአባታችን ከጌታም ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋና ሰላም ለእናንተ ይሁን።

verses.en: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,
verses.fr: Je rends grâces à mon Dieu de tout le souvenir que je garde de vous,

verses.en: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,
verses.fr: ne cessant, dans toutes mes prières pour vous tous, de manifester ma joie
verses.am: ሁልጊዜ በጸሎቴ ሁሉ ስለ እናንተ ሁሉ በደስታ እየጸለይሁ፥ ከፊተኛው ቀን እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ወንጌልን በመስበክ አብራችሁ ስለ ሠራችሁ፥ ባሰብኋችሁ ጊዜ ሁሉ አምላኬን አመሰግናለሁ።

verses.en: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;
verses.fr: au sujet de la part que vous prenez à l''Evangile, depuis le premier jour jusqu''à maintenant.
verses.am: ሁልጊዜ በጸሎቴ ሁሉ ስለ እናንተ ሁሉ በደስታ እየጸለይሁ፥ ከፊተኛው ቀን እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ወንጌልን በመስበክ አብራችሁ ስለ ሠራችሁ፥ ባሰብኋችሁ ጊዜ ሁሉ አምላኬን አመሰግናለሁ።

verses.en: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:
verses.fr: Je suis persuadé que celui qui a commencé en vous cette bonne oeuvre la rendra parfaite pour le jour de Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: በእናንተ መልካምን ሥራ የጀመረው እስከ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ቀን ድረስ እንዲፈጽመው ይህን ተረድቼአለሁና፤

verses.en: Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, ye all are partakers of my grace.
verses.fr: Il est juste que je pense ainsi de vous tous, parce que je vous porte dans mon coeur, soit dans mes liens, soit dans la défense et la confirmation de l''Evangile, vous qui tous participez à la même grâce que moi.
verses.am: በእስራቴም ወንጌልንም መመከቻና መጽኛ በማድረግ ሁላችሁ ከእኔ ጋር በጸጋ ተካፋዮች ስለ ሆናችሁ፥ በልቤ ትኖራላችሁና ስለ ሁላችሁ ይህን ላስብ ይገባኛል።

verses.en: For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ.
verses.fr: Car Dieu m''est témoin que je vous chéris tous avec la tendresse de Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ፍቅር ሁላችሁን እንዴት እንድናፍቃችሁ እግዚአብሔር ምስክሬ ነውና።

verses.en: And this I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment;
verses.fr: Et ce que je demande dans mes prières, c''est que votre amour augmente de plus en plus en connaissance et en pleine intelligence

verses.en: That ye may approve things that are excellent; that ye may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ.
verses.fr: pour le discernement des choses les meilleures, afin que vous soyez purs et irréprochables pour le jour de Christ,
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔርም ክብርና ምስጋና ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ የሚገኝ የጽድቅ ፍሬ ሞልቶባችሁ፥ ለክርስቶስ ቀን ተዘጋጅታችሁ ቅኖችና አለ ነውር እንድትሆኑ የሚሻለውን ነገር ፈትናችሁ ትወዱ ዘንድ፥ ፍቅራችሁ በእውቀትና በማስተዋል ሁሉ ከፊት ይልቅ እያደገ እንዲበዛ ይህን እጸልያለሁ።

verses.en: Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God.
verses.fr: remplis du fruit de justice qui est par Jésus-Christ, à la gloire et à la louange de Dieu.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔርም ክብርና ምስጋና ከኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ የሚገኝ የጽድቅ ፍሬ ሞልቶባችሁ፥ ለክርስቶስ ቀን ተዘጋጅታችሁ ቅኖችና አለ ነውር እንድትሆኑ የሚሻለውን ነገር ፈትናችሁ ትወዱ ዘንድ፥ ፍቅራችሁ በእውቀትና በማስተዋል ሁሉ ከፊት ይልቅ እያደገ እንዲበዛ ይህን እጸልያለሁ።

verses.en: But I would ye should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel;
verses.fr: Je veux que vous sachiez, frères, que ce qui m''est arrivé a plutôt contribué aux progrès de l''Evangile.
verses.am: ነገር ግን፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ ይህ የደረሰብኝ በእውነት ወንጌልን ለማስፋት እንደ ሆነ ታውቁ ዘንድ እወዳለሁ።

verses.en: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;
verses.fr: En effet, dans tout le prétoire et partout ailleurs, nul n''ignore que c''est pour Christ que je suis dans les liens,
verses.am: ስለዚህም እስራቴ ስለ ክርስቶስ እንዲሆን በንጉሥ ዘበኞች ሁሉና በሌሎች ሁሉ ዘንድ ተገልጦአል፥

verses.en: And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.
verses.fr: et la plupart des frères dans le Seigneur, encouragés par mes liens, ont plus d''assurance pour annoncer sans crainte la parole.
verses.am: በጌታም ካሉት ወንድሞች የሚበዙት ስለ እስራቴ ታምነው የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እንዲነግሩ ያለ ፍርሃት ከፊት ይልቅ ይደፍራሉ።

verses.en: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:
verses.fr: Quelques-uns, il est vrai, prêchent Christ par envie et par esprit de dispute; mais d''autres le prêchent avec des dispositions bienveillantes.
verses.am: አንዳንዶች ከቅንአትና ከክርክር እንኳ ሌሎች ግን ከበጎ ፈቃድ የተነሣ ክርስቶስን ይሰብኩታል፤

verses.en: The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:
verses.fr: Ceux-ci agissent par amour, sachant que je suis établi pour la défense de l''Evangile,
verses.am: እነዚህ ወንጌልን መመከቻ ለማድረግ እንደ ተሾምሁ አውቀው በፍቅር ይሰብካሉ፥

verses.en: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.
verses.fr: tandis que ceux-là, animés d''un esprit de dispute, annoncent Christ par des motifs qui ne sont pas purs et avec la pensée de me susciter quelque tribulation dans mes liens.
verses.am: እነዚያ ግን በእስራቴ ላይ መከራን ሊያመጡብኝ መስሎአቸው፥ ለወገናቸው የሚጠቅም ፈልገው በቅን አሳብ ሳይሆኑ ስለ ክርስቶስ ያወራሉ።

verses.en: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.
verses.fr: Qu''importe? De toute manière, que ce soit pour l''apparence, que ce soit sincèrement, Christ n''est pas moins annoncé: je m''en réjouis, et je m''en réjouirai encore.
verses.am: ምን አለ? ቢሆንም በሁሉ ጎዳና፥ በማመካኘት ቢሆን ወይም በቅንነት ቢሆን፥ ክርስቶስ ይሰበካል ስለዚህም ደስ ብሎኛል።

verses.en: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
verses.fr: Car je sais que cela tournera à mon salut, grâce à vos prières et à l''assistance de l''Esprit de Jésus-Christ,
verses.am: ወደ ፊትም ደግሞ ደስ ይለኛል፤ ይህ በጸሎታችሁና በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ መንፈስ መሰጠት ለመዳኔ እንዲሆንልኝ አውቃለሁና፥

verses.en: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.
verses.fr: selon ma ferme attente et mon espérance que je n''aurai honte de rien, mais que, maintenant comme toujours, Christ sera glorifié dans mon corps avec une pleine assurance, soit par ma vie, soit par ma mort;
verses.am: ይህ ናፍቆቴ ተስፋዬም ነውና፤ በአንድ ነገር እንኳ አላፍርም ነገር ግን በህይወት ብኖር ወይም ብሞት፥ ክርስቶስ በግልጥነት ሁሉ እንደ ወትሮው አሁን ደግሞ በስጋዬ ይከብራል።

verses.en: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
verses.fr: car Christ est ma vie, et la mort m''est un gain.
verses.am: ለእኔ ሕይወት ክርስቶስ፥ ሞትም ጥቅም ነውና።

verses.en: But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I wot not.
verses.fr: Mais s''il est utile pour mon oeuvre que je vive dans la chair, je ne saurais dire ce que je dois préférer.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በስጋ መኖር ለእኔ የሥራ ፍሬ ቢሆን፥ ምን እንድመርጥ ኣላስታውቅም።

verses.en: For I am in a strait betwixt two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better:
verses.fr: Je suis pressé des deux côtés: j''ai le désir de m''en aller et d''être avec Christ, ce qui de beaucoup est le meilleur;
verses.am: በእነዚህም በሁለቱ እጨነቃለሁ፤ ልሄድ ከክርስቶስም ጋር ልኖር እናፍቃለሁ፥ ከሁሉ ይልቅ እጅግ የሚሻል ነውና፤

verses.en: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.
verses.fr: mais à cause de vous il est plus nécessaire que je demeure dans la chair.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በሥጋ መኖሬ ስለ እናንተ እጅግ የሚያስፈልግ ነው።

verses.en: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;
verses.fr: Et je suis persuadé, je sais que je demeurerai et que je resterai avec vous tous, pour votre avancement et pour votre joie dans la foi,
verses.am: ይሁን እንጂ፥ መጥቼ ባያችሁ ወይም ብርቅ፥ በአንድ ልብ ስለ ወንጌል ሃይማኖት አብራችሁ እየተጋደላችሁ፥ በአንድ መንፈስ እንድትቆሙ ስለ ኑሮአችሁ እሰማ ዘንድ፥ ለክርስቶስ ወንጌል እንደሚገባ ኑሩ።

verses.en: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.
verses.fr: afin que, par mon retour auprès de vous, vous ayez en moi un abondant sujet de vous glorifier en Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: ይሁን እንጂ፥ መጥቼ ባያችሁ ወይም ብርቅ፥ በአንድ ልብ ስለ ወንጌል ሃይማኖት አብራችሁ እየተጋደላችሁ፥ በአንድ መንፈስ እንድትቆሙ ስለ ኑሮአችሁ እሰማ ዘንድ፥ ለክርስቶስ ወንጌል እንደሚገባ ኑሩ።

verses.en: Only let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that ye stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;
verses.fr: Seulement, conduisez-vous d''une manière digne de l''Evangile de Christ, afin que, soit que je vienne vous voir, soit que je reste absent, j''entende dire de vous que vous demeurez fermes dans un même esprit, combattant d''une même âme pour la foi de l''Evangile,
verses.am: በአንድም ነገር እንኳ በተቃዋሚዎች አትደንግጡ፤ ይህም ለእነርሱ የጥፋት፥ ለእናንተ ግን የመዳን ምልክት ነው፥ ይህም ከእግዚአብሔር ነው፤

verses.en: And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God.
verses.fr: sans vous laisser aucunement effrayer par les adversaires, ce qui est pour eux une preuve de perdition, mais pour vous de salut; et cela de la part de Dieu,
verses.am: ይህ ስለ ክርስቶስ ተሰጥቶአችኋልና፤ ስለ እርሱ መከራ ደግሞ ልትቀበሉ እንጂ በእርሱ ልታምኑ ብቻ አይደለም፤

verses.en: For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake;
verses.fr: car il vous a été fait la grâce, par rapport à Christ, non seulement de croire en lui, mais encore de souffrir pour lui,
verses.am: በእኔ ያያችሁት አሁንም በእኔ እንዳለ የምትሰሙት፥ ያው መጋደል ደርሶባችኋልና።

verses.en: Having the same conflict which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.
verses.fr: en soutenant le même combat que vous m''avez vu soutenir, et que vous apprenez maintenant que je soutiens.
verses.am: በእኔ ያያችሁት አሁንም በእኔ እንዳለ የምትሰሙት፥ ያው መጋደል ደርሶባችኋልና።

verses.en: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,
verses.fr: Si donc il y a quelque consolation en Christ, s''il y a quelque soulagement dans la charité, s''il y a quelque union d''esprit, s''il y a quelque compassion et quelque miséricorde,
verses.am: በክርስቶስም አንዳች ምክር ቢሆን፥ የፍቅር መጽናናት ቢሆን፥ የመንፈስ ኅብረት ቢሆን፥ ምሕረትና ርኅራኄ ቢሆኑ፥ ደስታዬን ፈጽሙልኝ፤

verses.en: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.
verses.fr: rendez ma joie parfaite, ayant un même sentiment, un même amour, une même âme, une même pensée.
verses.am: በአንድ አሳብ ተስማሙ፥ አንድ ፍቅር አንድም ልብ አንድም አሳብ ይሁንላችሁ፤

verses.en: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.
verses.fr: Ne faites rien par esprit de parti ou par vaine gloire, mais que l''humilité vous fasse regarder les autres comme étant au-dessus de vous-mêmes.
verses.am: ለወገኔ ይጠቅማል በማለት ወይም በከንቱ ውዳሴ ምክንያት አንድ እንኳ አታድርጉ፥ ነገር ግን እያንዳንዱ ባልንጀራው ከራሱ ይልቅ እንዲሻል በትሕትና ይቍጠር፤

verses.en: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.
verses.fr: Que chacun de vous, au lieu de considérer ses propres intérêts, considère aussi ceux des autres.
verses.am: እያንዳንዱ ለራሱ የሚጠቅመውን አይመልከት፥ ለባልንጀራው ደግሞ እንጂ።

verses.en: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:
verses.fr: Ayez en vous les sentiments qui étaient en Jésus-Christ,
verses.am: በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ የነበረ ይህ አሳብ በእናንተ ዘንድ ደግሞ ይሁን።

verses.en: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:
verses.fr: lequel, existant en forme de Dieu, n''a point regardé comme une proie à arracher d''être égal avec Dieu,
verses.am: እርሱ በእግዚአብሔር መልክ ሲኖር ሳለ ከእግዚአብሔር ጋር መተካከልን መቀማት እንደሚገባ ነገር አልቈጠረውም፥

verses.en: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:
verses.fr: mais s''est dépouillé lui-même, en prenant une forme de serviteur, en devenant semblable aux hommes;
verses.am: ነገር ግን የባሪያን መልክ ይዞ በሰውም ምሳሌ ሆኖ ራሱን ባዶ አደረገ፥

verses.en: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.
verses.fr: et ayant paru comme un simple homme, il s''est humilié lui-même, se rendant obéissant jusqu''à la mort, même jusqu''à la mort de la croix.
verses.am: በምስሉም እንደ ሰው ተገኝቶ ራሱን አዋረደ፥ ለሞትም ይኸውም የመስቀል ሞት እንኳ የታዘዘ ሆነ።

verses.en: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi aussi Dieu l''a souverainement élevé, et lui a donné le nom qui est au-dessus de tout nom,
verses.am: በዚህ ምክንያት ደግሞ እግዚአብሔር ያለ ልክ ከፍ ከፍ አደረገው፥ ከስምም ሁሉ በላይ ያለውን ስም ሰጠው፤

verses.en: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;
verses.fr: afin qu''au nom de Jésus tout genou fléchisse dans les cieux, sur la terre et sous la terre,
verses.am: ይህም በሰማይና በምድር ከምድርም በታች ያሉት ሁሉ በኢየሱስ ስም ይንበረከኩ ዘንድ፥

verses.en: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
verses.fr: et que toute langue confesse que Jésus-Christ est Seigneur, à la gloire de Dieu le Père.
verses.am: መላስም ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር አብ ክብር ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጌታ እንደ ሆነ ይመሰክር ዘንድ ነው።

verses.en: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.
verses.fr: Ainsi, mes bien-aimés, comme vous avez toujours obéi, travaillez à votre salut avec crainte et tremblement, non seulement comme en ma présence, mais bien plus encore maintenant que je suis absent;
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ ወዳጆቼ ሆይ፥ ሁልጊዜ እንደ ታዘዛችሁ፥ በእናንተ ዘንድ በመኖሬ ብቻ ሳይሆን ይልቁን አሁን ስርቅ፥ በፍርሃትና በመንቀጥቀጥ የራሳችሁን መዳን ፈጽሙ፤

verses.en: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.
verses.fr: car c''est Dieu qui produit en vous le vouloir et le faire, selon son bon plaisir.
verses.am: ስለ በጎ ፈቃዱ መፈለግንም ማድረግንም በእናንተ የሚሠራ እግዚአብሔር ነውና።

verses.en: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:
verses.fr: Faites toutes choses sans murmures ni hésitations,
verses.am: በእነርሱም መካከል የሕይወትን ቃል እያቀረባችሁ በዓለም እንደ ብርሃን ትታያላችሁ፥ ስለዚህም በከንቱ እንዳልሮጥሁ በከንቱም እንዳልደከምሁ በክርስቶስ ቀን የምመካበት ይሆንልኛል።

verses.en: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;
verses.fr: afin que vous soyez irréprochables et purs, des enfants de Dieu irrépréhensibles au milieu d''une génération perverse et corrompue, parmi laquelle vous brillez comme des flambeaux dans le monde,
verses.am: በእነርሱም መካከል የሕይወትን ቃል እያቀረባችሁ በዓለም እንደ ብርሃን ትታያላችሁ፥ ስለዚህም በከንቱ እንዳልሮጥሁ በከንቱም እንዳልደከምሁ በክርስቶስ ቀን የምመካበት ይሆንልኛል።

verses.en: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.
verses.fr: portant la parole de vie; et je pourrai me glorifier, au jour de Christ, de n''avoir pas couru en vain ni travaillé en vain.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በእምነታችሁ መሥዋዕትና አገልግሎት ተጨምሬ ሕይወቴ እንኳ ቢፈስ፥ ደስ ብሎኛል፤ ከሁላችሁም ጋር አብሬ ደስ ብሎኛል፤

verses.en: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.
verses.fr: Et même si je sers de libation pour le sacrifice et pour le service de votre foi, je m''en réjouis, et je me réjouis avec vous tous.
verses.am: እናንተም ደግሞ እንዲሁ ደስ ይበላችሁ ከእኔም ጋር አብራችሁ ደስ ይበላችሁ።

verses.en: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.
verses.fr: Vous aussi, réjouissez-vous de même, et réjouissez-vous avec moi.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ኑሮአችሁን ሳውቅ እኔ ደግሞ ደስ እንዲለኝ ፈጥኜ ጢሞቴዎስን ልልክላችሁ በጌታ በኢየሱስ ተስፋ አደርጋለሁ።

verses.en: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.
verses.fr: J''espère dans le Seigneur Jésus vous envoyer bientôt Timothée, afin d''être encouragé moi-même en apprenant ce qui vous concerne.
verses.am: እንደ እርሱ ያለ፥ ስለ ኑሮአችሁ በቅንነት የሚጨነቅ፥ ማንም የለኝምና፤

verses.en: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.
verses.fr: Car je n''ai personne ici qui partage mes sentiments, pour prendre sincèrement à coeur votre situation;
verses.am: ሁሉ የራሳቸውን ይፈልጋሉና፥ የክርስቶስ ኢየሱስን አይደለም።

verses.en: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ's.
verses.fr: tous, en effet, cherchent leurs propres intérêts, et non ceux de Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ልጅ ለአባቱ እንደ ሚያገለግል ከእኔ ጋር ሆኖ ለወንጌል እንደ አገለገለ መፈተኑን ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.
verses.fr: Vous savez qu''il a été mis à l''épreuve, en se consacrant au service de l''Evangile avec moi, comme un enfant avec son père.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እንዴት እንደምሆን ባየሁ ጊዜ፥ እርሱን ቶሎ እንድልክ ተስፋ አደርጋለሁ፤

verses.en: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.
verses.fr: J''espère donc vous l''envoyer dès que j''apercevrai l''issue de l''état où je suis;
verses.am: ራሴ ደግሞ ግን ፈጥኜ እንድመጣ በጌታ ታምኜአለሁ።

verses.en: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.
verses.fr: et j''ai cette confiance dans le Seigneur que moi-même aussi j''irai bientôt.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ወንድሜንና ከእኔ ጋር አብሮ ሠራተኛ ወታደርም የሚሆነውን፥ የእናንተ ግን መልእክተኛ የሆነውና የሚያስፈልገኝን የሚያገለግለውን አፍሮዲጡን እንድልክላችሁ በግድ አስባለሁ፤

verses.en: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.
verses.fr: J''ai estimé nécessaire de vous envoyer mon frère Epaphrodite, mon compagnon d''oeuvre et de combat, par qui vous m''avez fait parvenir de quoi pourvoir à mes besoins.
verses.am: ሁላችሁን ይናፍቃልና፥ እንደ ታመመም ስለ ሰማችሁ ይተክዛል።

verses.en: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.
verses.fr: Car il désirait vous voir tous, et il était fort en peine de ce que vous aviez appris sa maladie.
verses.am: በእውነት ታሞ ለሞት እንኳ ቀርቦ ነበርና፤ ነገር ግን እግዚአብሔር ማረው፥ ኀዘን በኀዘን ላይ እንዳይጨመርብኝ ለእኔ ደግሞ እንጂ ለእርሱ ብቻ አይደለም።

verses.en: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.
verses.fr: Il a été malade, en effet, et tout près de la mort; mais Dieu a eu pitié de lui, et non seulement de lui, mais aussi de moi, afin que je n''eusse pas tristesse sur tristesse.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እንደ ገና ስታዩት ደስ እንዲላችሁ ለእኔም ኀዘኔ እንዲቃለል በብዙ ፍጥነት እልከዋለሁ።

verses.en: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.
verses.fr: Je l''ai donc envoyé avec d''autant plus d''empressement, afin que vous vous réjouissiez de le revoir, et que je sois moi-même moins triste.
verses.am: እንግዲህ በሙሉ ደስታ በጌታ ተቀበሉት፥ እርሱን የሚመስሉትንም አክብሩአቸው፤

verses.en: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:
verses.fr: Recevez-le donc dans le Seigneur avec une joie entière, et honorez de tels hommes.
verses.am: በእኔ ዘንድ ካላችሁ አገልግሎት እናንተ ስለሌላችሁ የጎደለኝን እንዲፈጽም፥ በነፍሱ ተወራርዶ ከጌታ ሥራ የተነሣ እስከ ሞት ቀርቦአልና።

verses.en: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.
verses.fr: Car c''est pour l''oeuvre de Christ qu''il a été près de la mort, ayant exposé sa vie afin de suppléer à votre absence dans le service que vous me rendiez.
verses.am: በእኔ ዘንድ ካላችሁ አገልግሎት እናንተ ስለሌላችሁ የጎደለኝን እንዲፈጽም፥ በነፍሱ ተወራርዶ ከጌታ ሥራ የተነሣ እስከ ሞት ቀርቦአልና።

verses.en: Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.
verses.fr: Au reste, mes frères, réjouissez-vous dans le Seigneur. Je ne me lasse point de vous écrire les mêmes choses, et pour vous cela est salutaire.
verses.am: በቀረውስ፥ ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ በጌታ ደስ ይበላችሁ። ስለ አንድ ነገር መልሼ ልጽፍላችሁ እኔን አይታክተኝም ለእናንተ ግን ደኅና ነው።

verses.en: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision.
verses.fr: Prenez garde aux chiens, prenez garde aux mauvais ouvriers, prenez garde aux faux circoncis.
verses.am: ከውሾች ተጠበቁ፥ ከክፉዎችም ሠራተኞች ተጠበቁ፥ ከሐሰተኛም መገረዝ ተጠበቁ።

verses.en: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.
verses.fr: Car les circoncis, c''est nous, qui rendons à Dieu notre culte par l''Esprit de Dieu, qui nous glorifions en Jésus-Christ, et qui ne mettons point notre confiance en la chair.
verses.am: እኛ በመንፈስ እግዚአብሔርን የምናመልክ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስም የምንመካ በሥጋም የማንታመን እኛ የተገረዝን ነንና።

verses.en: Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinketh that he hath whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more:
verses.fr: Moi aussi, cependant, j''aurais sujet de mettre ma confiance en la chair. Si quelque autre croit pouvoir se confier en la chair, je le puis bien davantage,
verses.am: እኔ ግን በሥጋ ደግሞ የምታመንበት አለኝ። ሌላ ሰው ማንም ቢሆን በሥጋ የሚታመንበት እንዳለው ቢመስለው፥ እኔ እበልጠዋለሁ።

verses.en: Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as touching the law, a Pharisee;
verses.fr: moi, circoncis le huitième jour, de la race d''Israël, de la tribu de Benjamin, Hébreu né d''Hébreux; quant à la loi, pharisien;
verses.am: በስምንተኛው ቀን የተገረዝሁ፥ ከእስራኤል ትውልድ፥ ከብንያም ወገን፥ ከዕብራውያን ዕብራዊ ነኝ፤ ስለ ሕግ ብትጠይቁ፥ ፈሪሳዊ ነበርሁ፤

verses.en: Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; touching the righteousness which is in the law, blameless.
verses.fr: quant au zèle, persécuteur de l''Eglise; irréprochable, à l''égard de la justice de la loi.
verses.am: ስለ ቅንዓት ብትጠይቁ፥ ቤተ ክርስቲያንን አሳዳጅ ነበርሁ፤ በሕግ ስለሚገኝ ጽድቅ ብትጠይቁ፥ ያለ ነቀፋ ነበርሁ።

verses.en: But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ.
verses.fr: Mais ces choses qui étaient pour moi des gains, je les ai regardées comme une perte, à cause de Christ.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ለእኔ ረብ የነበረውን ሁሉ ስለ ክርስቶስ እንደ ጉዳት ቈጥሬዋለሁ።

verses.en: Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ,
verses.fr: Et même je regarde toutes choses comme une perte, à cause de l''excellence de la connaissance de Jésus-Christ mon Seigneur, pour lequel j''ai renoncé à tout, et je les regarde comme de la boue, afin de gagner Christ,

verses.en: And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:
verses.fr: et d''être trouvé en lui, non avec ma justice, celle qui vient de la loi, mais avec celle qui s''obtient par la foi en Christ, la justice qui vient de Dieu par la foi,
verses.am: አዎን፥ በእውነት ከሁሉ ይልቅ ስለሚበልጥ ስለ ክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ስለ ጌታዬ እውቀት ነገር ሁሉ ጉዳት እንዲሆን እቈጥራለሁ፤ ስለ እርሱ ሁሉን ተጐዳሁ፥ ክርስቶስንም አገኝ ዘንድ፥ በክርስቶስም በማመን ያለው ጽድቅ ማለት በእምነት ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ያለው ጽድቅ እንጂ ከሕግ ለእኔ ያለው ጽድቅ ሳይሆንልኝ፥ በእርሱ እገኝ ዘንድ ሁሉን እንደ ጕድፍ እቈጥራለሁ፤

verses.en: That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death;
verses.fr: Afin de connaître Christ, et la puissance de sa résurrection, et la communion de ses souffrances, en devenant conforme à lui dans sa mort,
verses.am: አሁን እንዳገኘሁ ወይም አሁን ፍጹም እንደ ሆንሁ አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን ስለ እርሱ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ የተያዝሁበትን ያን ደግሞ እይዛለሁ ብዬ እፈጥናለሁ።

verses.en: If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead.
verses.fr: pour parvenir, si je puis, à la résurrection d''entre les morts.
verses.am: አሁን እንዳገኘሁ ወይም አሁን ፍጹም እንደ ሆንሁ አይደለም፥ ነገር ግን ስለ እርሱ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ የተያዝሁበትን ያን ደግሞ እይዛለሁ ብዬ እፈጥናለሁ።

verses.en: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus.
verses.fr: Ce n''est pas que j''aie déjà remporté le prix, ou que j''aie déjà atteint la perfection; mais je cours, pour tâcher de le saisir, puisque moi aussi j''ai été saisi par Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እኔ ገና እንዳልያዝሁት እቈጥራለሁ፤ ነገር ግን አንድ ነገር አደርጋለሁ፤ በኋላዬ ያለውን እየረሳሁ በፊቴ ያለውን ለመያዝ እዘረጋለሁ፥

verses.en: Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before,
verses.fr: Frères, je ne pense pas l''avoir saisi; mais je fais une chose: oubliant ce qui est en arrière et me portant vers ce qui est en avant,
verses.am: በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ከፍ ከፍ ያለውን የእግዚአብሔርን መጥራት ዋጋ እንዳገኝ ምልክትን እፈጥናለሁ።

verses.en: I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.
verses.fr: je cours vers le but, pour remporter le prix de la vocation céleste de Dieu en Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: እንግዲህ ፍጹማን የሆንን ሁላችን ይህን እናስብ፤ በአንዳች ነገርም ልዩ አሳብ ቢኖራችሁ፥ እግዚአብሔር ይህን ደግሞ ይገልጥላችኋል፤

verses.en: Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing ye be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you.
verses.fr: Nous tous donc qui sommes parfaits, ayons cette même pensée; et si vous êtes en quelque point d''un autre avis, Dieu vous éclairera aussi là-dessus.
verses.am: ሆኖም በደረስንበት በዚያ እንመላለስ።

verses.en: Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing.
verses.fr: Seulement, au point où nous sommes parvenus, marchons d''un même pas.
verses.am: ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እኔን የምትመስሉ ሁኑ፥ እኛም እንደ ምሳሌ እንደምንሆንላችሁ፥ እንዲሁ የሚመላለሱትን ተመልከቱ።

verses.en: Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as ye have us for an ensample.
verses.fr: Soyez tous mes imitateurs, frères, et portez les regards sur ceux qui marchent selon le modèle que vous avez en nous.
verses.am: ብዙዎች ለክርስቶስ መስቀል ጠላቶቹ ሆነው ይመላለሳሉና፤ ብዙ ጊዜ ስለ እነርሱ አልኋችሁ፥ አሁንም እንኳ እያለቀስሁ እላለሁ።

verses.en: (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ:
verses.fr: Car il en est plusieurs qui marchent en ennemis de la croix de Christ, je vous en ai souvent parlé, et j''en parle maintenant encore en pleurant.
verses.am: መጨረሻቸው ጥፋት ነው፥ ሆዳቸው አምላካቸው ነው፥ ክብራቸው በነውራቸው ነው፥ አሳባቸው ምድራዊ ነው።

verses.en: Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.)
verses.fr: Leur fin sera la perdition; ils ont pour dieu leur ventre, ils mettent leur gloire dans ce qui fait leur honte, ils ne pensent qu''aux choses de la terre.
verses.am: እኛ አገራችን በሰማይ ነውና፥ ከዚያም ደግሞ የሚመጣ መድኃኒትን እርሱንም ጌታን ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስን እንጠባበቃለን፤

verses.en: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.fr: Mais notre cité à nous est dans les cieux, d''où nous attendons aussi comme Sauveur le Seigneur Jésus-Christ,
verses.am: እርሱም ሁሉን እንኳ ለራሱ ሊያስገዛ እንደሚችልበት አሠራር፥ ክቡር ሥጋውን እንዲመስል የተዋረደውን ሥጋችንን ይለውጣል።

verses.en: Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.
verses.fr: qui transformera le corps de notre humiliation, en le rendant semblable au corps de sa gloire, par le pouvoir qu''il a de s''assujettir toutes choses.
verses.am: እርሱም ሁሉን እንኳ ለራሱ ሊያስገዛ እንደሚችልበት አሠራር፥ ክቡር ሥጋውን እንዲመስል የተዋረደውን ሥጋችንን ይለውጣል።

verses.en: Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi, mes bien-aimés, et très chers frères, vous qui êtes ma joie et ma couronne, demeurez ainsi fermes dans le Seigneur, mes bien-aimés!
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ የምወዳችሁና የምናፍቃችሁ፥ ደስታዬና አክሊሌ የምትሆኑ ወንድሞቼ ሆይ፥ እንዲሁ በጌታ ቁሙ፥ ወዳጆች ሆይ።

verses.en: I beseech Euodias, and beseech Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord.
verses.fr: J''exhorte Evodie et j''exhorte Syntyche à être d''un même sentiment dans le Seigneur.
verses.am: በአንድ አሳብ በጌታ እንዲስማሙ ኤዎድያንን እመክራለሁ ሲንጤኪንንም እመክራለሁ።

verses.en: And I intreat thee also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellowlabourers, whose names are in the book of life.
verses.fr: Et toi aussi, fidèle collègue, oui, je te prie de les aider, elles qui ont combattu pour l''Evangile avec moi, et avec Clément et mes autres compagnons d''oeuvre, dont les noms sont dans le livre de vie.
verses.am: አንተም ደግሞ በሥራዬ አብረህ የተጠመድህ እውነተኛ ሆይ፥ እንድታግዛቸው እለምንሃለሁ፤ ስሞቻቸው በሕይወት መጽሐፍ ከተጻፉት ከቀሌምንጦስና ደግሞ ከእኔ ጋር አብረው ከሠሩት ከሌሎቹ ጋር በወንጌል ከእኔ ጋር አብረው ተጋድለዋልና።

verses.en: Rejoice in the Lord always: and again I say, Rejoice.
verses.fr: Réjouissez-vous toujours dans le Seigneur; je le répète, réjouissez-vous.
verses.am: ሁልጊዜ በጌታ ደስ ይበላችሁ፤ ደግሜ እላለሁ፥ ደስ ይበላችሁ።

verses.en: Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand.
verses.fr: Que votre douceur soit connue de tous les hommes. Le Seigneur est proche.
verses.am: ገርነታችሁ ለሰው ሁሉ ይታወቅ።

verses.en: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
verses.fr: Ne vous inquiétez de rien; mais en toute chose faites connaître vos besoins à Dieu par des prières et des supplications, avec des actions de grâces.
verses.am: ጌታ ቅርብ ነው። በነገር ሁሉ በጸሎትና በምልጃ ከምስጋና ጋር በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ልመናችሁን አስታውቁ እንጂ በአንዳች አትጨነቁ።

verses.en: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.
verses.fr: Et la paix de Dieu, qui surpasse toute intelligence, gardera vos coeurs et vos pensées en Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: አእምሮንም ሁሉ የሚያልፍ የእግዚአብሔር ሰላም ልባችሁንና አሳባችሁን በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ይጠብቃል።

verses.en: Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things.
verses.fr: Au reste, frères, que tout ce qui est vrai, tout ce qui est honorable, tout ce qui est juste, tout ce qui est pur, tout ce qui est aimable, tout ce qui mérite l''approbation, ce qui est vertueux et digne de louange, soit l''objet de vos pensées.
verses.am: በቀረውስ፥ ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እውነተኛ የሆነውን ነገር ሁሉ፥ ጭምትነት ያለበትን ነገር ሁሉ፥ ጽድቅ የሆነውን ነገር ሁሉ፥ ንጹሕ የሆነውን ነገር ሁሉ፥ ፍቅር ያለበትን ነገር ሁሉ፥ መልካም ወሬ ያለበትን ነገር ሁሉ፥ በጎነት ቢሆን ምስጋናም ቢሆን፥ እነዚህን አስቡ፤

verses.en: Those things, which ye have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you.
verses.fr: Ce que vous avez appris, reçu et entendu de moi, et ce que vous avez vu en moi, pratiquez-le. Et le Dieu de paix sera avec vous.
verses.am: ከእኔ የተማራችሁትንና የተቀበላችሁትን የሰማችሁትንም ያያችሁትንም እነዚህን አድርጉ፤ የሰላምም አምላክ ከእናንተ ጋር ይሆናል።

verses.en: But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me hath flourished again; wherein ye were also careful, but ye lacked opportunity.
verses.fr: J''ai éprouvé une grande joie dans le Seigneur de ce que vous avez pu enfin renouveler l''expression de vos sentiments pour moi; vous y pensiez bien, mais l''occasion vous manquait.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አሁን ከጊዜ በኋላ ስለ እኔ እንደ ገና ልታስቡ ስለ ጀመራችሁ፥ በጌታ እጅግ ደስ ይለኛል፤ ጊዜ አጣችሁ እንጂ፥ ማሰብስ ታስቡ ነበር።

verses.en: Not that I speak in respect of want: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content.
verses.fr: Ce n''est pas en vue de mes besoins que je dis cela, car j''ai appris à être content de l''état où je me trouve.
verses.am: ይህን ስል ስለ ጉድለት አልልም፤ የምኖርበት ኑሮ ይበቃኛል ማለትን ተምሬአለሁና።

verses.en: I know both how to be abased, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need.
verses.fr: Je sais vivre dans l''humiliation, et je sais vivre dans l''abondance. En tout et partout j''ai appris à être rassasié et à avoir faim, à être dans l''abondance et à être dans la disette.
verses.am: መዋረድንም አውቃለሁ መብዛትንም አውቃለሁ፤ በእያንዳንዱ ነገር በነገርም ሁሉ መጥገብንና መራብንም መብዛትንና መጉደልን ተምሬአለሁ።

verses.en: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
verses.fr: Je puis tout par celui qui me fortifie.
verses.am: ኃይልን በሚሰጠኝ በክርስቶስ ሁሉን እችላለሁ።

verses.en: Notwithstanding ye have well done, that ye did communicate with my affliction.
verses.fr: Cependant vous avez bien fait de prendre part à ma détresse.
verses.am: ሆኖም በመከራዬ ከእኔ ጋር ስለ ተካፈላችሁ መልካም አደረጋችሁ።

verses.en: Now ye Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning giving and receiving, but ye only.
verses.fr: Vous le savez vous-mêmes, Philippiens, au commencement de la prédication de l''Evangile, lorsque je partis de la Macédoine, aucune Eglise n''entra en compte avec moi pour ce qu''elle donnait et recevait; vous fûtes les seuls à le faire,
verses.am: የፊልጵስዩስ ሰዎች ሆይ፥ ወንጌል በመጀመሪያ ሲሰበክ፥ ከመቄዶንያ በወጣሁ ጊዜ፥ ከእናንተ ብቻ በቀር ሌላ ቤተ ክርስቲያን በመስጠትና በመቀበል ስሌት ከእኔ ጋር እንዳልተካፈለች እናንተ ደግሞ ታውቃላችሁ፤

verses.en: For even in Thessalonica ye sent once and again unto my necessity.
verses.fr: car vous m''envoyâtes déjà à Thessalonique, et à deux reprises, de quoi pourvoir à mes besoins.
verses.am: በተሰሎንቄ እንኳ ሳለሁ፥ አንድ ጊዜና ሁለት ጊዜ ያስፈለገኝን ሰዳችሁልኝ ነበርና።

verses.en: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.
verses.fr: Ce n''est pas que je recherche les dons; mais je recherche le fruit qui abonde pour votre compte.
verses.am: በስሌታችሁ የሚበዛውን ፍሬ እንጂ ስጦታውን ፈላጊ አይደለሁም።

verses.en: But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, wellpleasing to God.
verses.fr: J''ai tout reçu, et je suis dans l''abondance; j''ai été comblé de biens, en recevant par Epaphrodite ce qui vient de vous comme un parfum de bonne odeur, un sacrifice que Dieu accepte, et qui lui est agréable.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሁሉ አለኝ ይበዛልኝማል፤ የመዓዛ ሽታና የተወደደ መሥዋዕት የሚሆነውን ለእግዚአብሔርም ደስ የሚያሰኘውን ስጦታችሁን ከአፍሮዲጡ ተቀብዬ ተሞልቼአለሁ።

verses.en: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
verses.fr: Et mon Dieu pourvoira à tous vos besoins selon sa richesse, avec gloire, en Jésus-Christ.
verses.am: አምላኬም እንደ ባለ ጠግነቱ መጠን በክብር በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ የሚያስፈልጋችሁን ሁሉ ይሞላባችኋል።

verses.en: Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.fr: A notre Dieu et Père soit la gloire aux siècles des siècles! Amen!
verses.am: ለአምላካችንና ለአባታችንም እስከ ዘላለም ድረስ ክብር ይሁን፤ አሜን።

verses.en: Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you.
verses.fr: Saluez tous les saints en Jésus-Christ. Les frères qui sont avec moi vous saluent.
verses.am: ለቅዱሳን ሁሉ በክርስቶስ ኢየሱስ ሰላምታ አቅርቡ። ከእኔ ጋር ያሉቱ ወንድሞች ሰላምታ ያቀርቡላችኋል።

verses.en: All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar's household.
verses.fr: Tous les saints vous saluent, et principalement ceux de la maison de César.
verses.am: ቅዱሳን ሁሉ ይልቁንም ከቄሣር ቤት የሆኑቱ ሰላምታ ያቀርቡላችኋል።

verses.en: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
verses.fr: Que la grâce du Seigneur Jésus-Christ soit avec votre esprit!
verses.am: የጌታችን የኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ጸጋ ከመንፈሳችሁ ጋር ይሁን፤ አሜን።
